Chapter 75 Talent (Recommended)

Hearing Zhong Yu's unceremonious words, the faces of all the officials were ugly for a while, which made them feel a little unhappy when they were just satisfied with the feudal kingdom.

But when he saw the figure with a cold and cruel face on the throne, his heart felt cold, and he suddenly remembered that this person was not a good talker.

In Yizhou before, millions of nobles were killed in Yizhou, so that there is no one who can read in Yizhou now. And Jingzhou also killed tens of thousands of people around Jiangling. This is not an emperor who obeys others.

Now his identity is just a surrender, and he has been appeased, and now he dares to openly smear the face of his future boss.

With the tyrannical temper of this boss, I don't know how he will treat himself in the future? Thinking of this, Qiqi couldn't help but shudder, and the cold sweat dripped down his body.

But he no longer dared to speak out to refute Zhong Yu's opinion.

Seeing the courtiers below, he finally understood his identity, Zhong Yu immediately stopped looking at them and said to himself:

"Now I have 200,000 elite troops in the royal army, which will be used as the center to defend the emperor and deter dissidents from all over the world. We still need a large army to conquer the world, so we set up a new army for the conquest!"

Hearing this, Situ Wangyun, who wanted to do something in this kind of opportunity, said:

"I don't know how many soldiers and horses your Majesty needs to form? What are your requirements?"

Zhong Yu glanced at Wang Yun, didn't care about his heart at all, just nodded slightly to express his satisfaction with him, and comforted him.

"The number of the army is not large, but a mere one million people can still be supported by the power of the whole country!"

Hearing the huge number in Zhong Yu's mouth, and the words of making offerings with the power of the whole world. All the officials standing next to His Highness changed their faces, knowing that this was implying that they would pay to support the army of millions.

A burst of anger couldn't help rising in my heart, but thinking of the fate of those gentry in Jingzhou and Yizhou, I couldn't help but poured cold water on it again, extinguishing the terrible thoughts that had just arisen in my heart.

Instead of his whole family being ransacked and all the savings of the clan being taken away without leaving any, it is better to give away most of his property on his own initiative, and get the chance of survival and the feudal kingdom that Zhong Yu is now compensating for.

Among the two options of dying now and living with compensation, everyone chose the latter option, wisely told Zhong Yu that they supported the formation of a large army, and voluntarily donated the property of their own clan to help the emperor calm down the world one step earlier .

Suddenly, the court became a place where officials and officials from all walks of life competed for wealth. If you donate a thousand gold, I will donate ten thousand gold.

For a while, you come and go, competing to express your loyalty to Zhong Yu, lest Zhong Yu think you are stingy and refuse to pay.

This leaves a bad impression in my heart, and I will settle accounts later when I have time. Seeing from the side, neither standing nor sitting, Lingdi was embarrassed for a while.

I used to be like those ministers, it was difficult to ask him for a load of food and grass, but now they took the initiative to donate their wealth, and it was still too huge to count.

This tells him how to deal with himself, and at the same time, there is a burst of joy in his heart, telling you that if you refuse to give it to me, you will still be snatched away by others, and you deserve it.

It didn't take long for it to be large enough to feed a million troops for three years, and the taxes of the past ten years of the Han Dynasty were donated from the mouths of these officials.

In a burst of heartache, all the princes of the imperial court withdrew from the court, and returned to their homes trembling, their hearts twitching.

Zhong Yu also returned to his bedroom, went down to the court satisfied, and happily prepared to recruit troops. An army of one million is not a small number, and it must have a detailed plan to arrange it.

Three days later, an order about recruiting troops was conveyed to all parts of the Imperial Kingdom. This time it is not a conscription system, but a recruitment system, and the soldiers and horses trained are more elite.

And the 80 captured in order to attack Luoyang City before

The 400,000 cannon fodders who were relatively old, weak, sick and disabled, or whose physical fitness did not meet the requirements were also dismissed. Only 400,000 soldiers were left who were relatively strong and had the fighting will to meet the requirements of being a soldier.

Since this time it was recruiting soldiers, those who served as soldiers were paid their salaries and received pensions when they died. All the soldiers joined the army enthusiastically.

As for whether the imperial court has money to send them as military salaries, will they be reluctant to pay them? Those soldiers are not worried at all? They had heard it long ago, Zhong Yu privately ordered the news sent by the people.

The emperor just took out a large amount of military pay from the pockets of those officials and ministers, enough for millions of people to eat food for three years, and the money that the court has not collected taxes for ten years, how could they be afraid that the court would not be able to pay them military pay? !

As for being reluctant to give it, it is even more ridiculous. The emperor even gave his own land to his subjects as a country.

Just as a landlord is willing to distribute his lifeblood, good land, to his tenants, how can such a generous emperor be reluctant to part with such a little military salary!

Therefore, the enthusiasm of the people all over the world to join the army is still very high. Wave after wave of ordinary people were bought by Zhong Yu while joining the army, and the world became more stable.

After January, joining the army in various places is still going on, and the 400,000 strong men who have been reorganized by Lao Na are ready to be led by the four generals to quell the rebellion and accept the inheritance of the Han Dynasty.

Wherever the army passed by, all places surrendered one after another, and detailed forms were sent to the camps of the major generals, expressing their loyalty and surrender, except for a few people who were stubborn, but they were immediately leveled by the army.

Five months later, all the territory of the entire Han Dynasty was taken over by the Yu Kingdom, and all the rebellions were put down. The Yu Kingdom was filled with singing and dancing, and the scene of peace seemed to be visible at any time.

And the conscription work, which took half a year and six months, is also coming to an end at this time. A total of 600,000 elite soldiers were summoned to the barracks for half a year of training.

Half a year later, these 600,000 recruits will go out with the 400,000 veterans to attack Xianbei, and they must recognize his 200,000 elites from the millions of people.

At that time, it will be 200,000, plus Luoyang's 200,000 for a total of 400,000 elite soldiers, which will be the capital for attacking the barbarians in the main world.

As for himself, he also issued a recruitment order during the past six months, in which he expressed his earnest expectation of looking forward to talents and ruling the world with him.

And this lived up to my expectations, the world's talents poured into my net like crucian carp crossing the river, and talents from all over the world recommended themselves to their government one after another.

Among them are many well-known advisers and generals during the Three Kingdoms period. It can be said that most of the talents have been recruited by him. Except for those who have not yet been born, or who are only a few years old, the Three Kingdoms can be said to have been passed on by himself.

With these talents, I don't have to worry about talent reserves for a long time in the main world.

And the technical talents from all over the place were also concentrated in Luoyang City under his own order, so that the people from all over the place wanted to make a piece of iron for plowing the ground, but they couldn't find a blacksmith to do it, which made the people of the world feel a little bit resentful.

However, none of these things will be taken into consideration by that superior ruler, Zhong Yu.
